entities.name: Alkyl bromide N-O heterocycle
observations: Brominated aliphatic N–O heterocycle acts as the likely SN2 electrophile; exact substrate identity was unresolved in ORD.
No exact empirical reaction record was found for the generic substrate query.

entities.name: 4-Hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one
observations: Recognized as the second reactant; PubChem-resolved SMILES was C1=COC(=O)C=C1O.
Its oxygenated conjugated heterocycle is the likely nucleophile after base deprotonation.
No exact empirical ORD reaction record was found for this core.

entities.name: SN2 O-alkylation
observations: Most likely transformation is Williamson-type O-alkylation: oxygen nucleophile from 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one displaces bromide from the aliphatic substrate to form a C–O–C bond.
This assignment is mechanistic inference rather than a matched database precedent.

entities.name: Carbonate base polar aprotic
observations: Plausible conditions are K2CO3 or Cs2CO3 in DMF, acetone, or MeCN, with room temperature to moderate heating, approximately 40–80 °C.
NaH is a stronger alternative when carbonate bases do not provide sufficient conversion.
